description: \pc charset keyword with IBM CP437 \'hh bytes
notes: \pc is code page 437 and \pca is 850; the two disagree across most of 0x9B-0xFC, so treating 'OEM' as one thing is a real bug and not a pedantic one. Every byte is defined in 437, so nothing here can decode to U+FFFD once the `codepage` feature is on.
